title: The Endoplasmic Reticulum: A Central Hub for Dermal Collagen Quality Control and Its Profound Implications for Skin Health and Disease

contributions.purpose: 综述 ER 对真皮前胶原折叠与质量控制的机制
contributions.mechanism: 梳理 ER 内 Hsp47、PDI、钙联蛋白/钙网蛋白、脯氨酰/赖氨酰羟化酶、羟赖氨酸糖基化对三螺旋组装与 PTM 的调控
contributions.evaluation: 综述性归纳,无原创实验;仅引胶原组成(I 型 80-90%、III 型 10-15%)等文献值
contributions.domain: 皮肤生物学 / 细胞蛋白稳态
contributions.source_quote: This review delineates the critical ER-centric mechanisms governing dermal procollagen biogenesis and quality surveillance

contributions.purpose: 将 ER 质控失衡与皮肤衰老/纤维化关联并倡议其为治疗靶点
contributions.mechanism: 论述错误折叠前胶原→ER 应激→UPR 激活→真皮基质受损,提出增强伴侣/调节羟化酶/微调 UPR/补充维C 等方向
contributions.source_quote: we aim to underscore its significance as a therapeutic target for maintaining skin health and ameliorating collagen-related dermatological pathologies
